title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
slides: Legora just raised $550M — but why now?
The legal AI startup is now valued at $8.8B
Its growth came from lawyers, not engineers
Firms using it now reshape how contracts get reviewed
Ask your legal team what tools they actually use
thread_text:
1. $550M. But Why Now?

Legora just closed a $550M round — the largest legal AI raise this year. The question isn't the number. It's why investors moved this fast.

2. $8.8B Is a Signal

That valuation puts Legora above most legal tech incumbents. It means the market now prices AI legal tools as core infrastructure, not experiments.

3. Lawyers Built This Growth

The product spread through lawyers, not engineers. Adoption came from the people actually reviewing contracts — not from a top-down tech mandate.

4. Contract Review Rewired

Firms using it now run first-pass review through AI and send humans to the edge cases. The billable hour model is already bending around that workflow.

5. Ask Your Legal Team

Ping them today: what tools are actually open on their screen? If they can't name one, that gap is your next conversation.
